narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Rhombuses come in many shapes, so the angle at O could be anything.
<bookmark mark='two'/>A thin rhombus and a fat rhombus do look very different.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Looks are not proof. We must reason about the angle at the crossing.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>In every rhombus, the diagonals bisect each other and cross at a right angle.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A rhombus has diagonals of ten and four centimetres. Find the halves and the angle.
